narrative: On the board. The Verona page on the desk, daylight, the pen capped. One name in the list stands as it was written last night. No new couplet under it. No speech. On the board. Empty paper under the name. Further down, the days are still an open mark. No new ink.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the name already on the page and did not add a line.

entities.name: Romeus and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on draft in The friar's name
